Inside the school

A living practice

Your principal teacher

Yoga Acharya Samir Rane

Samir Rane is the principal teaching faculty at Yoga & Meditation School of India. He comes from a yogic family in India where yoga has been kept as a living tradition, and is the third generation to carry it forward.

Associated with yoga for over 28 years, he has taught across Australia, New Zealand and India, and thousands have attended his public classes in Melbourne.
